blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Computer vision offers a scalable, non-contact means of estimating livestock traits, but correlated images and video frames make reliable evaluation difficult. Image-random splitting can place views of the same animal in both training and test sets, while deployment further requires transfer to animals captured in future years. We introduce BoviShift, a corpus reconstructed from six consecutive annual cohorts of an operational cattle marketplace collected from 2021 to 2026. It contains 2{,}657 cattle, 10{,}610 still images, and 2{,}566 walk-around videos across nine recorded breed categories. We evaluate three splitting strategies through four configurations: image-random and pooled cattle-disjoint splits over the same development cohorts, followed by separate future-2025 and locked future-2026 evaluations. Using a fixed ResNet-50 multi-task baseline, we assess weight, age, height, breed, and coat color. Differences between image-random and cattle-disjoint splitting are task-dependent rather than a universal leakage penalty. Future-cohort behavior is also attribute- and cohort-specific: breed declines relative to pooled evaluation; mean weight and age performance fails to beat constant baselines in 2025; height remains above baseline; and color transfers well to 2025 but degrades in 2026. Multi-task training improves all five point estimates in a single-seed ablation, still-view aggregation helps selectively, and zero-shot video-frame aggregation exposes a still-to-video domain gap. To our knowledge, BoviShift is the longest-spanning cattle-vision resource combining consecutive annual cohorts with physical and visual attributes.

blocks.en:
Estimating livestock traits from images could reduce reliance on manual
measurement and specialized equipment. Weighing cattle conventionally requires
a crush, scale, and trained handler, whereas photographs can be acquired with a
phone. This distinction matters where weighing infrastructure is unavailable
and sale decisions depend on visual judgment. Recent methods report promising
errors for image-based weight estimation [ 1 , 7 , 12 ] .

blocks.en: 2.1 Visual estimation of livestock traits

blocks.en:
Body-weight estimation from imagery has a long lineage in precision livestock

controlled capture. Point-cloud approaches using depth sensors report mean
absolute percentage errors near 3% on herds of around one hundred
animals [ 7 ] , and depth-image pipelines for dairy calves reach
comparable accuracy [ 12 ] . More

such system reports accuracy above 97% for weight estimation from a mobile

blocks.en: Dulal et al. [3] report that the bottleneck for multi-view 3D reconstruction is data: producing 3D-suitable capture at scale on working farms is difficult. BoviShift contributes 2,566 walk-around videos collected during routine marketplace operations using a simple handheld acquisition process. Although these are not calibrated 3D captures, their scale and viewpoint variation provide a useful resource for developing and evaluating reconstruction methods under less controlled conditions. The SAM 3D Animal model of Hu et al. [8] builds on the SMAL family, which recovers shape only up to an unknown scale and was fitted predominantly to taurine and general quadruped morphology. Whether it faithfully represents the thoracic hump and dewlap of Bos indicus cattle is not established, and a metric weight estimate cannot be obtained without an explicit calibration step. We therefore treat reconstruction as a direction the corpus enables rather than a baseline we adopt uncritically.

Our reference model uses an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 encoder [ 6 ] followed by dropout ( p = 0.2 p=0.2 ), one linear classification head for each of breed
and color, and a joint linear head for the three continuous attributes. Regression
targets are standardized using the training-set mean and standard deviation.

inverse-frequency-weighted cross-entropy over the two classification tasks,
with weights computed from training image rows, and (ii) Smooth- L 1 L_{1} loss over
all valid standardized regression targets. Thus, the classification and
regression components each have coefficient one; no test-set metric is used to
tune their relative weighting.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
The experiments yield three main observations. First, P1 and P2 produce
task-dependent differences rather than a universal leakage penalty. Because
P1 nevertheless places the same cattle in training and test, it remains an
unsuitable estimate of deployment performance. Second, the future-2025
configuration is markedly harder for breed and the physical attributes than
pooled cattle-disjoint evaluation, while color behaves differently in 2025
and 2026. Generalization is therefore both attribute- and cohort-specific.
Third, the large across-seed variation in weight estimation shows that a
single training run is insufficient evidence of robustness. Additional
observations are also selective: curated still aggregation benefits some
physical attributes, whereas naive video-frame averaging exposes a
still-to-video domain gap.
blocks.zh:
实验得出了三大观测结果. 第一,P1和P2产品
取决于任务的差别,而不是普遍的渗漏处罚。 因为
不过,P1将同样的牛放入训练和测试中,它仍然是
部署业绩估计不当。 第二,未来2025年
配置对于品种和物理属性来说明显比
2025年牛与牛的杂交评价,而颜色表现不同
还有2026年。 因此,一般化既针对属性,也针对组别。
第三,体重估计方面的大跨种子变化表明,
单期培训不足以证明培训的力度。 额外
观察也具有选择性:
自然属性,而天真的视频帧平均显示
仍为视频域间隙.

blocks.en:
These results motivate a practical reporting standard: partition by cattle
identity, include a held-out future cohort, report multiple optimization
seeds, aggregate and evaluate at cattle level, and obtain uncertainty by
resampling cattle rather than correlated images. Image-random results may be
reported as a diagnostic, but not as evidence of deployment generalization.
blocks.zh:
这些结果促使制定了实用报告标准:由牛分化。
身份,包括一个被搁置的未来组群,报告多重优化
种子,在牛群一级进行聚合和评价,并获得不确定性
给牛进行再取样,而不是进行相干图像。 图像随机结果可能
报告为诊断,但不作为部署一般化的证据。

blocks.en:
BoviShift also has important limitations. It is reconstructed from one
operational marketplace, so annual differences combine changes in population,
capture practice, operations, and annotation rather than isolating calendar
time. P1–P2 and P2–P3 consequently compare fixed experimental
configurations, not causal effects, and each uses one split realization.
Breed labels are imbalanced, color is binary, and marketplace metadata may
contain measurement or transcription error. Our baseline uses one encoder
family; P4 and the single-task ablation use one training seed, and checkpoint
bootstrap intervals do not capture retraining variation. Finally, video
evaluation is zero-shot, and 54 P3 test cattle lack videos. Future work should
test additional model families, split realizations, and video-specific methods
under the same fixed identity-disjoint temporal evaluation strategy.
blocks.zh:

因此,年度差异 结合人口的变化,
抓取惯例、操作和注释,而不是孤立日历

配置,而不是因果效应,每个都使用一个分解实现.

包含测量或复制错误。 我们的基线使用一个编码器
家庭;P4和单任务取消使用一个培训种子和检查站
靴子间隔不能反映再培训的变化。 最后,视频
评分为零发,54个P3测试牛缺乏视频. 今后的工作应
测试更多模式家庭、分割实现和视频专用方法
同一固定身份 -- -- 脱节时间评估战略。
